topic.meaning: General-knowledge cute: small rounded soft form, gentle handling and quietly delighted response. Not a named behavioral archetype or a requester-defined fixed costume.

concept.summary: An adult toy restorer supports a repaired plush seal and straightens its folded flipper while sharing a pleased look with the camera.

generate actual image and assess semantic application

one_frame_observable_criteria.description: The toy reads as a small, soft, rounded seal rather than a flat symbol or merely a cute word.
One adult palm supports the toy; fingers of the other hand gently adjust its flipper, with readable physical contact and plausible ownership.
The adult has a pleased camera acknowledgement and recognizable reference face/hair without facial infantilization.
A fresh stitched belly patch remains visible.
Face, paired hands and toy carry the frame; workshop context remains subordinate.

pixel_rule: Report each authored criterion independently. All actual hard/opt-in gates will be enumerated from the returned pack; partial evidence fails a gate. Do not promote an authored criterion to a user lock.
